{{Top|leg}}
A '''claqa''' was a [[Bilar]] [[Hive mind/Legends|hive mind]]. Individual Bilars were unintelligent, and only gained intelligence when joined in a claqa. [[Unni Yerudi]] was a Bilar claqa with ten members.
